indicators.name: Simple Moving Average
indicators.description: The plain average of the source price over the last N sessions, every session weighted the same.

indicators.name: Exponential Moving Average
indicators.description: An average of the source price over N sessions that weights recent sessions more, so it turns sooner than the SMA.

indicators.name: Weighted Moving Average
indicators.description: An average of the source price over N sessions with linearly rising weights: the newest session counts most.

indicators.name: Hull Moving Average
indicators.description: A moving average built from weighted averages over N and N/2 sessions, so it follows price closely with little lag.

indicators.name: Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average
indicators.description: A moving average that speeds up while price trends cleanly and slows down while it moves sideways (efficiency over N sessions).

indicators.name: MACD
indicators.description: The gap between a fast and a slow EMA of price, with a signal line (an EMA of the gap) and their difference as the histogram.

params.label: Holders
params.text: Top-K: at each session the K brokers with the largest positive inventory over the lookback (ties by broker code); selected: the brokers named; all: every broker with a row in the loaded window.

params.label: Brokers
params.text: Read with holders "Selected brokers": 1 to 5 broker codes.

params.label: Top K
params.text: Read with holders "Top-K holders" (the Terminal draws at most 5 brokers).

params.label: Series
options: c · Inventory ÷ traded value of the lookback (%)
params.text: a: the Terminal's cumulative inventory counted from the first of the lookback's sessions; b: the Terminal's daily net; c: a as a percent of every investor's traded value on the chosen boards over the same sessions.

params.label: Lookback (sessions)
params.text: The L sessions ending at the evaluated candle: the inventory counts from the first of them; Top-K holders are ranked on it; series c divides by their traded value.

params.label: Holders that moved: by at least
params.text: Read by output count, in the series' unit: lots or rupiah for a and b, percent of the traded value for c; a holder counts when its series is above 0 and at least this (rose) or below 0 and at most minus this (fell).

flows.formula: Series a: the Terminal's Broker Inventory (cumulative net lots or rupiah) of each holder, counted from the first of the last L sessions, summed over the holders; b: the Terminal's daily net of the holders; c: 100 x the holders' inventory over the L sessions / every investor's traded value (gross buy) on the chosen boards over the same sessions. Holders: the K brokers with the largest positive inventory over the L sessions, the brokers named, or every broker. Output count: how many holders' series rose (fell) by at least the amount.
flows.misuse: An inventory is a net of the broker's clients over the sessions counted, not a holding: it starts at zero on the first of them. Series a and b scale with the stock's size (use c to compare stocks).

flows.name: Foreign Net Value
flows.tip: Foreign investors' net buying (buy value minus sell value) in rupiah over the last sessions.
flows.formula: Sum over the last D sessions of the buy value minus the sell value of every broker row with investor type Foreign on the chosen boards (every board by default), in rupiah; missing unless the session has broker data and the D sessions start at or after the stock's first session with broker data.
flows.misuse: Investor type, not broker domicile. A rupiah amount grows with the stock's size (Net Flow / Turnover Ratio with all brokers and Foreign investors compares stocks). One Nego block can dominate on every board.

flows.name: Major-Holder Net Change (KSEI)
flows.tip: Net change of the 5% holders' stakes reported to KSEI over the last sessions.
flows.formula: Sum of the KSEI-reported changes (percentage points of the shares) of the stock's major holders with a position date in the last D sessions.
flows.misuse: KSEI dates are position-report dates and many prices are estimates; not point-in-time for past dates.
